known_limits: Every complete first source needed consequential refinement; actual-content type specimens did not establish full-operation quality.
This small controlled model study does not establish causal improvement, unfamiliar-person success, all-Agent/model reliability or commercial acceptance.
Local Chromium and emulated touch/short heights do not establish physical-device, software-keyboard, assistive-technology or Safari/Firefox behavior.
Real guide waits establish rehearsal elapsed-time recovery. Synthetic document-visibility checks establish only their labelled lifecycle branches.
Cue: long supported names may require scrolling between full identity and transport on a short phone; short cue names are recommended.
Unavailable browser storage cannot preserve work through every reload/close/back action; inspected outgoing link fallbacks retain the active document.
Folio compact anchor context supplements the complete drawing; its standalone HTML is a reading record without import.
The new early representative-operation preview recommendation has not had a separate controlled first-draft comparison.

ship_review.scope: Source review plus actual local Chromium regression after the original trials. No new native installed-Agent or public-release claim.
regressions: Parcel protects wordmark, notice and guide during failed saving; normal saved navigation and same-document keyboard fragment remain usable.
Folio rejects recovered ID/number aliases; canonical recovery, unique new p4 selection, Save, Remove and Undo preserve identity.
ship_review.source_phase: ship-review for patched cases; per-file source and media phases remain explicit.
